The Sentry Tower Software team develops robotic systems that provide force protection capabilities, monitoring the perimeter of secure areas, land or sea, for approaching people, vehicles, and vessels. Our products leverage advanced sensor fusion and autonomy to seamlessly render activity in the environment to Lattice's common operating picture.
About the Job
Not every Sentry Tower does the same job. The same core platform that watches a perimeter for people and vehicles also underpins our ground-based air defense variants, where the tower's mission is detecting and tracking aircraft, and the sensor payload, the radar integration, and the configuration all shift accordingly. We're hiring a Software Engineer to develop and own the software for those variants, funded by and delivered to our Air Defense program. The threat they exist for is the cheap, fast, hard-to-see aircraft that has changed what defending a fixed site means. Detection has to happen with enough time left to do something about it, which puts the burden on how well the payload, the tracking, and the configuration actually work together on a real tower.
You will work in the same declarative NixOS platform the rest of the team builds on, owning your variants' slice of it: product configuration, radar and camera payload integration, networking, manufacturing test hooks, and the software update path. Some of this is new feature work driven by program requirements, and some of it is consolidation, because these variant configurations grew up separately from our modern platform base, and moving them onto it means understanding both well enough to prove nothing was lost in the move. This program delivers several products, a few of them tower variants, and those variants are what you'll work on. The result is that you end up knowing how they are put together better than anyone, which is genuinely useful to a team this size.
This is a good role for an engineer who wants breadth. You'll touch the radar and camera services, the network configuration, the build system, and the manufacturing and field tooling, with an experienced team around you owning each of those domains in depth. Develop features driven by Air Defense program requirements, working from program needs through design, implementation, and delivery into a shipping product.

Shield AI may be the place for you.
  
  
As a Mechanical Engineer on the Mechanisms team, you will contribute to the design, development, and integration of mechanical systems for Shield AI’s autonomous aircraft. Your work may include a focus on gearbox development and integration, including gears, shafts, bearings, housings, lubrication systems, and related interfaces.

* Support the design and integration of mechanical mechanisms for autonomous aircraft, potentially including gearboxes and other power-transmission systems
* Create and update 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, bills of materials, and interface documentation
* Complete defined design tasks involving component sizing, material selection, tolerance analysis, and mechanical packaging
* Perform foundational structural, kinematic, and machine-design calculations with guidance from senior engineers
* Assist with preliminary finite element analysis and document assumptions, methods, and results
* Support the selection and integration of gears, bearings, shafts, splines, seals, fasteners, and lubrication components
* Help build, inspect, test, and iterate prototype hardware for functionality, performance, and reliability
* Support pre-production builds, aircraft integration, and ground and flight testing
* Investigate well-defined technical issues, document findings, and contribute to root-cause and corrective-action activities
* Collaborate with mechanical, propulsion, electrical, avionics, flight-controls, manufacturing, and test teams
* Follow established engineering, configuration-management, and product-release processes
* Develop plans for assigned tasks, communicate progress and risks, and incorporate feedback from teammates

* Academic, internship, student-team, research, or project experience using 3D CAD software
* Ability to create or interpret basic engineering drawings
* Familiarity with dimensional tolerancing and GD&T fundamentals
* Ability to perform foundational engineering calculations and clearly document assumptions and results
* Hands-on interest in designing, building, integrating, or testing mechanical hardware
* Strong problem-solving, organization, documentation, and communication skills
* Ability to complete well-defined engineering tasks with guidance from peers and managers
* Ability to collaborate effectively, accept feedback, and work in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities
* A demonstrated record of working hard, being trustworthy, holding yourself to high standards, and being kind to others
* Ability to obtain an S//SAR-level security clearance is desired

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Internship, student-team, research, or project experience involving aircraft, UAVs, robotics, automotive systems, or other mechanical products
* Coursework or project experience related to gearboxes, gearing, bearings, shafts, splines, seals, lubrication, or rotating machinery
* Familiarity with gear geometry, gear-train calculations, bearing selection, or mechanical power transmission
* Experience with NX or a similar production CAD platform
* Exposure to tolerance stack-ups, mechanical fits, and GD&T application
* Exposure to finite element analysis, including static, modal, buckling, or fatigue analysis
* Familiarity with MATLAB, Python, or other engineering analysis tools
* Hands-on machine-shop, mechanic, fabrication, assembly, or inspection experience through professional, academic, or hobby activities
* Exposure to FMEA, design of experiments, root-cause analysis, or reliability testing
* Familiarity with additive manufacturing, machining, casting, forging, or other mechanical manufacturing processes
* Exposure to RTCA DO-160, MIL-STD-810, structural testing, vibration testing, or mechanism testing
* Ability to thrive in startup, R&D, or defense-innovation environments

**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Do you want to solve business challenges through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on innovative, scalable services technology in a team environment? Do you like working on industry-defining projects that move the needle?
  
  
At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use latest technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand.
  
  
The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years. If this sounds interesting to you, apply and come chart your own path at Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Collaborate with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market.
* Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry.
* Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed.
* Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.
* Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems.
* Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software.
